Two ties were hit (Gigi Tolentino / Anujan Kumaranathan at 210%, Pratik Raval / Joana Reid at 154%) and both were broken by workflow_drift emission order — deterministic and stable across re-runs, but not the rule as written.

Action ids are a deterministic composite (`plan-<rule>-<finding ref>`), not a hash as contracts/plan-schema.md specifies. The planner's tool grant is Read and Write with no Bash, so it has no way to compute one. The stability property the contract cares about holds — same finding, same id on re-run — but the ids are legible rather than opaque. Either the contract should permit a deterministic composite or the planner needs a hashing step.

Ingest should emit ids for rolled-up findings, or the contract should state the reconstruction rule.
